conclusions.text: The retained 2017 geoBoundaries KIR ADM1 file contains three features with 29 Gilbert, 11 Phoenix and 5 Line source components; the exact source bytes and per-part bounds are reproducible.

The 19 Atlas Table 3 Gilbert entries are census/reporting rows rather than a one-to-one physical-island geometry inventory; North/South Tarawa and North/South Tabiteuea are reporting divisions of Tarawa and Tabiteuea. The present sources and retained Atlas subject parts do not establish exact row-to-island boundaries.

GeoBoundaries Phoenix component 1 is strongly associated with Kanton by its near-identical bounds to #526 OSM coastline way 22391694, but exact historical polygon equality and administrative jurisdiction remain unverified.

The two retained remainder parts are near Banaba/Tarawa and candidate-bounded by source Phoenix components 2/4; exact island identity, full historic archive aliases, the remaining source pieces and shared parent correction remain unresolved.
Political ownership is not decided or inferred from macro membership.
Official sources list 17 physical Gilbert, 8 Phoenix and 8 Line island groups; these named groupings are not administrative boundaries or a vector completeness proof.

The pinned undated archive contains no exact normalized name rows for the 33 Kiribati physical groups in the locations/units collections; its Makin, Caroline and Washington exact-name collisions have unrelated parents. A miss is not proof of geographic or historical absence.
The linked council warrant/profile scans were byte-hashed but their text and effective dates could not be reliably extracted; statutory jurisdiction boundaries remain unresolved.

The 33-row physical-name crosswalk resolves Gilbert census-row names, eight Phoenix names to the eight retained #526 member IDs, and Gilbert/Line group-level retained IDs; exact island-to-source-component geometry remains unresolved.
